metadata.title: chore: remove flake8, darglint, dlint; replace with ruff D417
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Remove three redundant linters (flake8, darglint, dlint) whose checks are fully covered by ruff and bandit
- Add ruff D417 rule as a direct replacement for darglint's DAR101 (missing argument descriptions)

## Details

**Removed linters:**
- **flake8** — pycodestyle E/W and pyflakes F rules already selected in ruff
- **darglint** — archived/unmaintained since 2023; replaced by ruff D417
- **dlint** — DUO security rules redundant with bandit B-series checks

**Added:**
- **ruff D417** — checks for missing argument descriptions in docstrings, replacing darglint DAR101

**Scope of changes (45 files):**
- Config: delete `.flake8`, `.darglint`; update `pyproject.toml`, `Makefile`, CI workflows, pre-commit configs
- Packaging: remove from `MANIFEST.in` (5 files), `.dockerignore` (5 files)
- Python: clean up `# noqa: DUO*` / `# flake8: noqa:` comments (7 files)
- Docs: replace `flake8` with `ruff` in command examples (~15 files)
- Editor: remove flake8 from `.nvim.lua` ALE config

## Test plan

- [ ] `make ruff` passes
- [ ] CI lint matrix runs without flake8/darglint/dlint jobs
- [ ] No `flake8`/`darglint`/`dlint` references remain (except `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-bugbear]` which is ruff's own config, and historical CHANGELOG/roadmap entries)

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: `linting-python-docsig` references `$(LINT_DOCSIG_TARGET)`, but that variable is not defined anywhere in the Makefile, so this target will run docsig with an empty/invalid path. Define `LINT_DOCSIG_TARGET` (likely mirroring the old `LINT_DARGLINT_TARGET` default) or switch the target to use the existing variable name so the scan runs on the intended directory.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
`linting-full` is a passing gate workflow and now includes `linting-python-docsig`. In `.github/workflows/lint.yml` docsig is intentionally non-blocking (`|| true`) due to existing SIG violations, but `linting-full` will fail hard as soon as docsig reports those pre-existing issues. Either keep docsig out of `LINTING_FULL_TARGETS` until the baseline is clean, or make the `linting-python-docsig` gate explicitly non-blocking / opt-in so merges to main aren’t blocked unexpectedly.
```suggestion
LINTING_FULL_TARGETS := linting-workflow-actionlint linting-workflow-reviewdog linting-workflow-commitlint linting-helm-lint linting-helm-chart-testing linting-helm-unittest linting-go-gosec linting-go-govulncheck
```
